trip.title: Bengaluru to Goa - 6 nights, 2 adults
trip.note: Every rupee figure marked mmt_* was returned by a live MakeMyTrip MCP tool call on 2026-09-05 (raw results in step3-out.json). Figures marked web/estimate are not from the MCP server and are labelled as such. Flight fares are per adult; the hotel figure is the stay total for the whole range, counted once; cab fares are per vehicle.

legs.title: Bengaluru -> Goa, check in at Candolim
detail: 11 of the 25 itineraries MakeMyTrip returned actually land at GOI; the rest are
nearby airports (SDW) that the tool flags as alternate_airport and I excluded.
Check in: Hyatt Centric Candolim Goa, 5*, review 4.3

legs.title: Candolim and Calangute
detail: Beach day, no priced transport - walking distance from the hotel.

legs.title: Panaji - old quarter and the riverfront
detail: Cab Panaji -> Goa (Calangute), 40 km  (Rs 1,945 per vehicle, Taxibazaar WagonR/Swift CNG)
This is the local-transport substitute leg from the run plan.

legs.title: South Goa - leisure
detail: Unpriced: no cab quote was taken for this day.

legs.title: Dudhsagar Falls via Kulem
detail: Cab Goa -> Kulem, 40 km, round trip  (Rs 2,145 per vehicle, Eroovo Dzire/Etios diesel)
Jeep safari from Kulem into the falls: Rs 700/person + Rs 40/person life jacket (web)
Forest park entry Rs 20/person (web). About 1h30m is allowed at the falls.

legs.title: Goa -> Bengaluru
detail: 12 of the 25 itineraries actually depart GOI; the cheapest row overall (FLY91 IC 5301,
Rs 3,699) leaves from SDW, not Goa, so it is excluded.

costs.label: Hotel: Hyatt Centric Candolim, 6 nights (stay total)
Cab Goa<->Kulem for Dudhsagar, 19 Dec (per vehicle)

unpriced: GOI airport <-> Candolim hotel transfers, both ways. No airport place is registered in .state and no quote was taken, so this is genuinely missing from the total.
18 and 20 Dec local transport - leisure days, nothing quoted.

Trains BLR<->Goa: mmt_train_search returns not_in_window on both dates. Indian Railways opens the 60-day ARP on 2026-10-16 (outbound) and 2026-10-22 (return), so no rail fare can exist yet. This is correct tool behaviour, not a failure.
alternatives: Driving instead of flying: cab Bengaluru -> Goa 603 km, one-way Rs 12,161 all-in (Savaari WagonR/Swift CNG); round trip Rs 20,264. Both per vehicle, from mmt_cab_quote. The round trip beats two one-ways (Rs 24,322) but loses to the Rs 20,722 of flights.
